name: Kelin Textile hotel linen catalogue
description: Series and model tables of Nantong Kelin Textile Co., Ltd. (Kelin Textile), a hotel linen manufacturer in Nantong, China: bedding sets, duvets, pillows, mattress toppers, mattress protectors, bed runners, bath linen, blankets and bedspreads. Values as published in the 2026 product deck and on the company's websites, each with its source.
note: Published with the design demo https://kelintextile.design; the company's official website is https://www.kelin-textile.com.
terms: Specifications as published by the company. No licence has been specified yet; cite the series page when reusing.

series.name: Plain White Series
series.summary: Hotel bedding sets in plain white 100% cotton from 300TC to 600TC, in Oxford or overlocking style with flange, ribbon or line-embroidery details.

series.name: Stripe Series
series.summary: Hotel bedding sets in 100% Cotton with a 1 cm or 3 cm stripe, 250TC to 400TC.

series.name: Jacquard Series
series.summary: Hotel bedding sets in jacquard cotton, 300TC and 400TC, Oxford style.

series.name: Eco-Friendly Series
series.summary: Hotel bedding sets in 100% Eucalyptus Bamboo or 100% Tencel, "Over locking" style.

series.name: Feather Duvet Series
series.summary: Hotel duvets filled with goose down, duck down or goose/duck feather in 100% cotton down-proof shells.

series.name: Down-Alternative Microfiber Duvet Series
series.summary: Hotel duvets with down-alternative microfiber fill, 200–600 gsm, in cotton or polyester shells.

series.name: Feather Pillow Series
series.summary: Hotel pillows filled with goose or duck down in 100% cotton 233TC covers, 1000–1800 g.

series.name: Microfiber Pillow Series
series.summary: Hotel pillows with 1.33D, 3D or 7D microfiber fill in 100% cotton covers, 1000–1800 g.

series.name: Functional Pillow Series
series.summary: Hotel pillows combining microfiber with buckwheat or lavender fill in 100% cotton covers.

series.name: Feather Topper Series
series.summary: Mattress toppers filled with goose or duck feather, 600–1300 gsm, in 233TC cotton down-proof fabric.

series.name: Down-Alternative Microfiber Topper Series
series.summary: Mattress toppers with down-alternative microfiber fill, 600–1200 gsm, in cotton or polyester fabric.

series.name: Standard Series
series.summary: Mattress protectors, quilted, in super soft microfiber, 100% Cotton 200TC or 100% Polyester with hollow fiber or microfiber fill.

series.name: Waterproof Protector Series (TPU Laminated)
series.summary: Waterproof mattress protectors with a 0.02 mm TPU layer on terry, microfiber diamond, bamboo jacquard or knitted polyester.

series.name: Waterproof & Specialty Series
series.summary: Waterproof mattress protectors with a 0.02 mm TPU layer or TPU lamination, including a 6-sided box style and a fitted-sheet style.

series.name: Hospital & Waterproof Fitted Sheet Series
series.summary: Fitted sheets and waterproof fitted sheets for hospital and healthcare beds in cotton, polycotton and microfiber, as listed on qltextiles.com.

series.name: Bed Runner Series
series.summary: Bed runners in 100% polyester for hotel beds, 50 cm wide in 180, 210 and 240 cm lengths.

values.Features: High-quality polyester fabric, durable and easy care, suitable for high-frequency hotel use

series.name: Decorative Pillow Series
series.summary: Decorative cushions in 100% polyester, 50×50 cm standard square, to match hotel bed runners.

values.Features: Premium polyester fabric, easy to clean and maintain, long-lasting beauty

series.name: Cotton Coverlet Series
series.summary: Cotton coverlets and flat bed covers, 40S to 120S yarn and 250TC to 800TC, custom colours.

values.Size: Twin, Full, King, Cal King, Single, Double, Super King

series.name: Polyester Bedspread Series
series.summary: Plain 100% polyester bedspread sets at 90 gsm, Twin to Super King.

values.Size: Twin, Full, Queen, King, Cal King, Single, Double, Super King

series.name: Flax Linen Bed Cover Series
series.summary: A 100% French flax linen bed cover in brick red, Twin to Super King.

values.Size: Twin, Full, Queen, King, Cal King, Single, Double, Super King

series.name: Raschel Blanket Series
series.summary: Raschel blanket comforter sets with 450 gsm microfiber filling and diagonal printing, Twin to Super King.

series.name: Cotton Towel Series (16s)
series.summary: Hotel towels in 100% cotton, 16s yarn and satin technique, in white, light grey, dark grey and malachite green.

series.name: Honeycomb Towel Series
series.summary: Honeycomb towels in 100% cotton, white, satin technique, standard size.

series.name: Custom Logo Towel Series
series.summary: Bath towels with an embroidered logo, 360–1100 gsm on one listing and 200–400 gsm on two, as listed on kelin-textile.com.

series.name: Knitted Cotton Solid Series
series.summary: Home bedding sets in knitted cotton, 250TC to 400TC with 40S or 60S yarn: 15 listings in a range of solid and two-tone colours.
